questions.q: Why do you write down definitions such as backlog and resolution time before building any reports?
options: Salesforce requires a definitions document before a report can be saved
Definitions make reports load faster
Dashboards cannot be created without them
Two analysts can get different answers from the same data if they define a term differently
questions.explain: Agreed definitions keep numbers consistent and protect you when a stakeholder asks why your figure differs from theirs.

questions.q: Which is the best rewrite of the worry "the queue is growing"?
options: Make the queue smaller
Ask each agent how busy they feel
How many cases are open at quarter end compared with quarter start, and are more opened than closed?
Count every case ever created
questions.explain: A good business question names a measure, a population, and a time window so it can be answered with data.

questions.q: The org has no field that records when an agent first replied to a case. What should you do about first response time?
options: Estimate it from the closed date and present it as fact
Say plainly that it is not tracked, and check whether a custom field, automation, or milestones could supply it
Silently drop it from the project
Use the case owner's name as a substitute
questions.explain: Standard Case fields do not capture first response in every org. Be transparent about the gap rather than inventing a number.

questions.q: What should always accompany a customer satisfaction score?
options: The agent's employee ID
A second score from another survey
The case's Origin value
The response count, so readers know how much data sits behind the score
questions.explain: A 4.8 average from three responses is far less reliable than a 4.3 from four hundred. The count gives context.

questions.q: How does Project 2 differ from Project 1?
options: Lessons give the goal and one worked example, and you choose more of the filters, groupings, and charts yourself
It uses no Salesforce reports
Each lesson prescribes every click
It is completed entirely in Tableau
questions.explain: Project 2 reduces the scaffolding so you practice making and justifying analytical decisions.
